title: A School Trip and a Birthday
text:
Our school trip is in April. It is on the eighth of April. We go to the zoo with our class. The day is sunny and warm.

My best friend is Ana. Her birthday is in August. We have a cake and we sing songs. Ana likes summer very much.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the trip?
Why does Ana probably enjoy her birthday?
options: She likes summer and she has a cake with friends
She does not like her friends

vocabulary.definition: a journey to a place, often for a short time
a place where people can see many kinds of animals
full of bright sunlight, with no clouds
the day of the year when a person was born

paragraph_translations: Nuestro viaje escolar es en abril. Es el ocho de abril. Vamos al zoológico con nuestra clase. El día es soleado y cálido.
Mi mejor amiga es Ana. Su cumpleaños es en agosto. Tenemos un pastel y cantamos canciones. A Ana le gusta mucho el verano.
